新しい空間係数はλ(x)=a+b(2x−1)、a∈[1,2.8]、b∈[−0.5,0.5]であり、以前の定数λモデルを拡張する。 合成観測と正の重みを固定し、パラメータの尺度・事前値・正則化強度を明記する。データだけの感度行列の階数と、正則化後の系の階数を区別する。 境界条件: u(0)=u(1)=0を両係数に依存せず固定し、観測位置も区間[0,1]内で固定する。 単位系: 状態・座標・係数は無次元。観測重みとパラメータ尺度を明記し、特異値と正則化強度の尺度依存を区別する。 Bratuの逆問題：随伴勾配によるλ推定の専用配布版 定数λを1個推定する既存配布版です。同じ離散化での回復、連続解析解からの観測、固定摂動を分けて検証します。2パラメータの拡張は次の別配布版で扱います。 取得・実行手順 / README · コード・検査・観測データ・図 ZIP · 楕円は選択γを固定した局所Gauss–Newton線形モデルのplug-inです。非線形残差の二階微分、γ選択のランダム性、選択事象で条件づけた共分散、事後分布、被覆率を扱いません。全γ連続経路・実測データも未検証。 取得・実行手順 / README · コード・検査・観測データ・図 ZIP · ファイル目録・SHA-256 · 30件成功・検証記録 Read the formulation Read the chapter Assumptions for this example Smooth lower-branch Bratu states on a fixed mesh with a locally nonsingular state Jacobian and fixed zero Dirichlet data. The new spatial coefficient is lambda(x)=a+b(2x-1), with a in [1,2.8] and b in [-0.5,0.5]; this extends the earlier constant-lambda model. Fixed synthetic observations, positive weights and explicitly stated parameter scales, priors and regularization strengths; data-only sensitivity rank is separate from a regularized system rank. Boundaries: u(0)=u(1)=0 independent of both coefficients; fixed observation locations on [0,1]. Units: Dimensionless state, coordinate and coefficients. Observation weights and parameter scales are explicit; singular values and regularization strengths depend on those scales. Bratu inverse problem: adjoint-gradient parameter fitting The existing edition fits one constant lambda and distinguishes same-discretization recovery, continuous analytic observations and fixed perturbations. The following separate edition provides the two-parameter extension. 取得・実行手順 / README · Code, tests, observations and figure ZIP · File manifest / SHA-256 · 23 tests passed / verification numart/bratu_inverse.py numart/bratu_sensitivity.py numart/autodiff.py numart/krylov.py scripts/build_bratu_inverse.py tests/test_bratu_inverse.py Adjoint gradients, fit histories, grid bias and fixed-noise records / JSON python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q tests/test_bratu_inverse.py python scripts/build_bratu_inverse.py MIT License · 適用範囲 / Licensing scope Multi-parameter Bratu inversion: regularization and identifiability Educational tests use small smooth lower-branch Bratu problems and fixed synthetic observations. They cover two spatial coefficients, Tikhonov regularization, local data-sensitivity SVD, rank loss with central observations and reflection ambiguity. Prior selection through regularization does not add observational information. Real data, high-dimensional function estimation, global uniqueness, statistical confidence intervals and quasi-Newton methods generally are outside scope. The preceding limitations describe earlier editions. This additional release: A local comparison on a small smooth branch. The optimizer library is shared by the reference and a companion; no global minimum or uniqueness proof is claimed. LM is not presented as a box-constrained method. No exact n-step termination or general global convergence on Rosenbrock is claimed. The selected original text uses weak Wolfe, distinct from this study’s strong Wolfe policy. Fletcher’s 1970 original article remains unread. Ellipses are plug-in noise propagation for a local Gauss–Newton linear model with the selected gamma treated as fixed. They omit nonlinear residual Hessians and selection randomness and are not selection-conditional covariance, a posterior or a coverage guarantee. Continuous gamma paths and real data remain unverified. 取得・実行手順 / README · Code, tests, observations and figure ZIP · File manifest / SHA-256 · 30 tests passed / verification
